title: HarnessContext Contract
description: S11 (spec MAWS-SII-TARGET-SPEC-001 v0.2.0, section 4.3): the harness context is a routing and binding dimension, never an authority source. The vocabulary is closed to development_harness and unitera_product. authority_grant is none by construction: no field of this record grants capability, permission, or qualification. A development_harness record must not carry an authority surface (a development run derives no product-runtime authority); the unitera_product record must reference -- never substitute or cache -- the unitera-os tenant/assignment authority surface as a versioned pin; product effects stay gated by execution-control decisions regardless of context. A context switch is a bound plan change evidenced on graph supersession (bound-execution-graph.schema.json superseded_by.context_change), never an implicit fallback recorded here.
